en_title: Mass Effect 5 Trailer Reportedly Ready to Go Before BioWare Closure
subtitle: 游戏已不复存在
opus_summary: 据称，EA取消《质量效应5》并关闭BioWare前，游戏预告片已准备就绪。彭博社称，当时约有50名员工参与开发；BioWare奥斯汀工作室据报道仍在运营，为EA多款在研游戏提供支持。

paragraphs.en: A Mass Effect 5 trailer was reportedly ready to go before EA canceled the game and shut BioWare down .
paragraphs.cn: 据称，在EA取消《质量效应5》并关闭BioWare之前，游戏预告片已经准备就绪。

paragraphs.en: This was mentioned in a post on the subreddit for Austin , Texas, where BioWare had a studio. An alleged EA worker said “a trailer ready for Mass Effect 5 that I saw a few months ago, so I’m puzzled as to how ‘early’ they were.” IGN understands there was indeed a Mass Effect 5 trailer ready for release.
paragraphs.cn: 这件事出现在一个关于得克萨斯州奥斯汀市的Reddit子版块帖子中，BioWare曾在那里设有工作室。一名自称是EA员工的用户表示：「几个月前我看到《质量效应5》的预告片已经准备好了，所以我不明白他们所说的‘早期’到底是怎么回事。」IGN获悉，《质量效应5》确实有一支已经准备发布的预告片。

paragraphs.en: This is in reference to EA’s solitary paragraph on BioWare’s closure and the cancelation of Mass Effect 5 in the memo Cam Weber, president and chief studios officer, and David Tinson, president and COO, sent to staff on Wednesday:
paragraphs.cn: 这指的是EA周三发给员工的备忘录中，关于BioWare关闭和取消《质量效应5》的唯一一段说明。备忘录由工作室总裁兼首席工作室官Cam Weber，以及总裁兼首席运营官David Tinson发出：

paragraphs.en: “As we focus on these larger opportunities, we've had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect. We've made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace. BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly.”
paragraphs.cn: 「随着我们将精力放在这些更大的机会上，BioWare一直有一支小团队负责《质量效应》的早期开发。我们决定不再推进这项开发工作，因此将关闭工作室及其埃德蒙顿办公地点。BioWare是一家传奇工作室，曾助力定义角色扮演游戏类型。我们做出这个决定并非轻率之举。」

paragraphs.en: The mention of the next Mass Effect being in “early development” has shocked some fans, given the game was announced at The Game Awards in December 2020. At the time, BioWare said the project was in “early production.” Six years later, Mass Effect is no more.
paragraphs.cn: EA提到新《质量效应》仍处于「早期开发」阶段，让一些粉丝感到震惊。毕竟，这款游戏早在2020年12月的TGA上就已公布。当时BioWare称项目处于「早期制作」阶段。六年过去，《质量效应》系列的新作如今已不复存在。

paragraphs.en: According to Bloomberg , BioWare had around 50 staff working on Mass Effect 5 when EA closed the studio, which comes after 2024’s launch of Dragon Age: The Veilguard failed to meet EA’s sales expectations. 400 jobs will reportedly go in total across EA, amounting to 3% of total staff.
paragraphs.cn: 据彭博社报道，EA关闭BioWare时，约有50名员工正在开发《质量效应5》。此前，EA于2024年推出的《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》未能达到公司的销售预期。据称，EA总计将裁撤400个职位，约占员工总数的3%。

paragraphs.en: BioWare’s Austin studio reportedly remains open, working to support various EA games in development. IGN has asked EA for comment.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，BioWare奥斯汀工作室仍在运营，为EA多款开发中的游戏提供支持。IGN已向EA询问此事。

paragraphs.en: The end of Mass Effect and BioWare comes just weeks before the annual N7 Day, set for November 7. Less than 12 months ago, Mike Gamble, executive producer of Mass Effect at BioWare, celebrated N7 Day to say the next Mass Effect game was still in development, to express excitement about the Amazon TV series ( which IGN understands is currently still in the works ), and to insist EA and BioWare "remain committed to telling more stories in this universe."
paragraphs.cn: 《质量效应》新作告终、BioWare关闭，距离定于11月7日举行的年度N7日仅剩几周。不到12个月前，BioWare《质量效应》执行制作人Mike Gamble还在N7日表示，新作仍在开发中，并表达了对亚马逊剧集的期待（IGN获悉，该剧目前仍在制作中），同时强调EA和BioWare「仍致力于讲述这个宇宙中的更多故事」。

paragraphs.en: Fans had hoped to see more of Mass Effect 5 on N7 Day next month, but it now seems likely to pass without fanfare. “You made me laugh. Thank you,” Gamble replied to one X / Twitter user who wondered what might be announced on N7 Day next month.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝原本希望能在下个月的N7日看到更多《质量效应5》的消息，但如今看来，这个日子很可能不会有任何特别动静。一名X用户（原Twitter用户）猜测下个月的N7日会公布什么，Gamble回复道：「你让我笑了，谢谢。」

paragraphs.en: Since yesterday’s dramatic news, a number of people who had worked on Mass Effect 5 talked in vague terms about the game it was shaping up to be . On X / Twitter, New York Times bestselling author Catherynne M. Valente responded to a user who said, “A game industry that cannot figure out how to make a sequel to the literal best game of all time is a game industry that is fundamentally broken,” with: “We did figure it out. We were working on a great game. Just saying.”
paragraphs.cn: 昨天传出这一令人震惊的消息后，多名曾参与《质量效应5》开发的人士含蓄地谈到了这款游戏原本会是什么样子。《纽约时报》畅销书作家Catherynne M. Valente在X上回应一名用户。该用户写道：「一个连如何为史上最佳游戏制作续作都想不明白的游戏行业，根本就是出了问题。」Valente则说：「我们想明白了。我们当时正在制作一款很棒的游戏。仅此而已。」

paragraphs.en: One person who was laid off from BioWare, cinematic supervisor Tony de Waal, took to LinkedIn to say Mass Effect 5 would have been “something special,” with “a level of autonomy and choice that no other game has been able to match.”
paragraphs.cn: 被BioWare裁撤的电影演出主管Tony de Waal在LinkedIn上表示，《质量效应5》本会「与众不同」，并拥有「其他游戏都无法匹敌的自主性和选择自由」。

paragraphs.en: “We saw what Larian and CD Projekt were bringing to the table with their latest offerings, and started down a path to bring Mass Effect to the next level while remaining true to the Trilogy,” he continued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「我们看到了Larian和CD Projekt在各自最新作品中展现的成果，于是开始探索一条道路，希望在忠于三部曲的同时，让《质量效应》更进一步。」

paragraphs.en: “I'm sad you won't ever get to see what we were cooking, and sad for the small, talented group of devs who were all punching above their weight to make something special. Please consider those who stayed with BioWare until the very end. They are truly some of the most talented people I've had the pleasure of working with throughout my career.”
paragraphs.cn: 「你们再也看不到我们原本在筹备什么，我对此感到难过；那群人数不多却才华横溢的开发者，为了做出特别的作品付出了远超自身条件的努力，我也为他们感到惋惜。请大家想想那些一直留在BioWare、坚持到最后的人。他们确实是我整个职业生涯中有幸共事过的最优秀的人才之一。」

paragraphs.en: We have much more on the dramatic news of BioWare's closure, including reaction from fans and the video game industry , IGN's Ryan McCaffrey on why BioWare was the greatest RPG developer ever , and Jacqueline Thomas on the sad loss of Mass Effect 5 .
paragraphs.cn: 关于BioWare关闭这一重大消息，我们还有更多报道，包括粉丝和游戏业界的反应、IGN的Ryan McCaffrey谈BioWare为何曾是史上最出色的RPG开发商，以及Jacqueline Thomas对《质量效应5》夭折的感想。
